problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 10 delivery routes through 10 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling tasks represented as pairs (Center, Duration), where each pair specifies the distribution center where the task must be performed and the time required to complete it. The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the tasks must be executed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C4, 5) → (C6, 6) → (C9, 5) → (C8, 5) → (C3, 3) → (C7, 7) → (C2, 10) → (C10, 7) → (C5, 4) → (C1, 10)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C2, 1) → (C4, 4) → (C5, 6) → (C9, 6) → (C6, 2) → (C10, 8) → (C3, 1) → (C1, 5) → (C8, 3) → (C7, 8)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C4, 6) → (C10, 10) → (C6, 9) → (C1, 3) → (C7, 2) → (C3, 2) → (C9, 3) → (C2, 7) → (C5, 5) → (C8, 2)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C9, 6) → (C5, 3) → (C3, 5) → (C6, 4) → (C4, 2) → (C7, 5) → (C2, 7) → (C10, 7) → (C8, 6) → (C1, 8)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C2, 1) → (C10, 6) → (C4, 8) → (C9, 5) → (C8, 10) → (C7, 5) → (C3, 6) → (C5, 3) → (C1, 1) → (C6, 10)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C5, 1) → (C3, 8) → (C1, 7) → (C4, 4) → (C7, 5) → (C8, 3) → (C6, 10) → (C9, 8) → (C2, 8) → (C10, 2)
* R7 requires the sequence: (C6, 2) → (C7, 2) → (C5, 2) → (C4, 4) → (C9, 7) → (C10, 8) → (C3, 2) → (C8, 10) → (C2, 8) → (C1, 1)
* R8 requires the sequence: (C9, 4) → (C3, 8) → (C10, 7) → (C7, 3) → (C6, 2) → (C4, 6) → (C8, 3) → (C1, 8) → (C2, 2) → (C5, 3)
* R9 requires the sequence: (C6, 8) → (C1, 9) → (C2, 1) → (C3, 5) → (C7, 7) → (C10, 10) → (C8, 2) → (C5, 5) → (C9, 6) → (C4, 9)
* R10 requires the sequence: (C9, 4) → (C7, 1) → (C5, 2) → (C3, 1) → (C1, 6) → (C4, 7) → (C2, 3) → (C8, 5) → (C10, 1) → (C6, 2)

Each handling task must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each distribution center can only handle one task at a time. The objective is to determine the processing order of all tasks at the distribution centers so that the total completion time of all routes is minimized.
